cues.text: A good ticket is like a message to the tailor. If it is clear, the job is done right, even if you are not there.
Find the customer on the Counter.
Tap Drop Off, then Alterations. Or use the Tailor screen on the iPad.
Pick the job, like pants hem or take in waist. The POS fills in the price.
Pick the color and how many pieces.
The POS picks a due date when the tailor has time. Tell the customer that date.
Tap Complete and Print. Put the tag on the garment.
Always write the details in the note: how much, like hem one and a half inches, both legs.
Was it pinned? What shoes? Keep the original hem? And anything special the customer asked for.
